[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has utilized the OnlyOffice platform to deliver malicious payloads to victims.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticore_May2026)

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has utilized webservices in attempts to provide a sense of legitimacy to its infrastructure to include *[.]azurewebsites[.]net.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticore_May2026)(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549_Feb2024)(Citation: Mandiant_UNC1549TTPsTools_Nov2025)      

[NIMBUS MANTICORE](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G1059) has also utilized Cloudflare.(Citation: CheckPoint_NimbusManticoreEurope_Sept2025)
